statements.t: The Company's lead product candidate, ifetroban, is being evaluated across multiple Phase 2 clinical programs targeting serious conditions with limited treatment options.

The Company intends to include the data in the NDA, and have it presented at an appropriate scientific conference (similar to the twelve-month data announcement), as well as through a study publication.

As next steps, we plan to submit the clinical study report to the FDA and complete correlative biomarker studies using specimens collected during the trial, along with cardiac imaging evaluations from patients continuing in the open-label extension.
We remain committed to executing our development strategy and look forward to reporting our continued progress.
For the tax year 2026, the Company expects to utilize these net operating loss carryforwards to offset the tax liability associated with the $81.1 million taxable gain.
Our continuing operations do not generate product revenues and we expect them to use cash to fund operations for the foreseeable future.

We believe that our internally generated cash flows, existing working capital and the proceeds from the Strategic Transaction will be adequate to finance internal growth, finance business development initiatives and fund capital expenditures for the foreseeable future.
